'''Rueb''' was a [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. As of [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]] she was in command of [[Freedom Station]], an Alliance space station in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that served as the base for attacks on a nearby [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] travel route.
